title: ADRB2 modulates asbestos-induced pleural mesothelioma progression by influencing IL-17/NF-kappaB-related inflammatory signalling: An integrated network toxicology, multi-omics and experimental study.
authors: Huang, Shaoyang; Gu, Dandan; He, Jintao; Hou, Guangsheng; Wang, Jundong; Li, Zhengliang; Yu, Min; Li, Jiangyan; Xiong, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络毒理学、多组学和实验研究石棉致胸膜间皮瘤中ADRB2经IL-17/NF-kB信号的作用，仅含分子对接且非蛋白-DNA互作核心，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a highly aggressive asbestos-related malignancy with a poor prognosis and limited early diagnostic options. In this study, network toxicology and integrated multi-omics analyses were used to investigate the molecular mechanisms by which chrysotile, crocidolite, and amosite may induce PM and to identify core diagnostic genes. Asbestos-related targets from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD) database were integrated with Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) transcriptomic datasets, followed by differential expression analysis, weighted gene co-expression network analysis, protein-protein interaction analysis, functional enrichment, machine-learning screening, and SHAP interpretation. Candidate targets were mainly enriched in inflammation-related pathways, including cytokine regulation, complement and coagulation cascades, NF-kappaB, TNF, and IL-17 signalling. Adrenergic receptor beta 2 (ADRB2), LMO3, GPD1L, EDNRB, RNASE1, PDK4, CAT, and MAL showed strong diagnostic contributions, among which ADRB2 displayed particular mechanistic relevance. Immune-infiltration and single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses suggested that ADRB2 was associated with multiple immune-cell populations and was distributed across both malignant and immune-cell compartments within the PM microenvironment, while molecular docking indicated potential interactions between asbestos and multiple core proteins. LDH assays showed that 2.5 mug/cm(2) represented a low-to-subtoxic exposure concentration in MeT-5A and MSTO-211H cells. At this concentration, all three asbestos types promoted proliferation, clonogenic growth, and invasion while up-regulating ADRB2, with crocidolite exerting the strongest effect. Mechanistically, ADRB2 knockdown attenuated crocidolite-induced IL-17/NF-kappaB-related signalling, reduced IL-6, CXCL1, and CXCL8 expression, and suppressed the malignant phenotype of MSTO-211H cells, whereas recombinant human IL-17A partially restored these effects. These findings identify ADRB2 as a potential diagnostic and mechanistic target in asbestos-related PM and suggest that ADRB2 may contribute to crocidolite-induced malignant progression by modulating cellular responses associated with IL-17/NF-kappaB-related inflammatory signalling.
abstract_zh: 胸膜间皮瘤（PM）是一种高度侵袭性的石棉相关恶性肿瘤，预后差且早期诊断手段有限。本研究采用网络毒理学和整合多组学分析，探讨温石棉、青石棉和铁石棉可能诱导PM的分子机制，并识别核心诊断基因。将比较毒理基因组学数据库（CTD）中的石棉相关靶点与基因表达综合数据库（GEO）转录组数据集整合，随后进行差异表达分析、加权基因共表达网络分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析、功能富集、机器学习筛选和SHAP解释。候选靶点主要富集于炎症相关通路，包括细胞因子调控、补体和凝血级联、NF-kappaB、TNF和IL-17信号通路。肾上腺素能受体β2（ADRB2）、LMO3、GPD1L、EDNRB、RNASE1、PDK4、CAT和MAL显示出较强的诊断贡献，其中ADRB2表现出特别的机制相关性。免疫浸润和单细胞RNA测序分析提示，ADRB2与多种免疫细胞群体相关，并分布于PM微环境中的恶性细胞和免疫细胞区室，而分子对接表明石棉与多种核心蛋白之间存在潜在相互作用。LDH实验显示，2.5 μg/cm²为MeT-5A和MSTO-211H细胞中的低至亚毒性暴露浓度。在此浓度下，三种石棉类型均促进增殖、克隆形成生长和侵袭，同时上调ADRB2，其中青石棉作用最强。机制上，ADRB2敲低减弱了青石棉诱导的IL-17/NF-kappaB相关信号传导，降低了IL-6、CXCL1和CXCL8表达，并抑制了MSTO-211H细胞的恶性表型，而重组人IL-17A部分恢复了这些效应。这些发现将ADRB2确定为石棉相关PM的潜在诊断和机制靶点，并提示ADRB2可能通过调节与IL-17/NF-kappaB相关炎症信号相关的细胞反应，参与青石棉诱导的恶性进展。
